3-way-filtered-kitchen-mixer-tap-stainle.shortDescription: Brushed Nickel 3-way kitchen mixer delivering hot, cold and filtered water from one tap. Compatible with standard 1/4" filter connections. WaterMark licence 032200 and WELS 4 Star.
3-way-filtered-kitchen-mixer-tap-stainle.description:
A 3-way filtered kitchen tap that gives you hot, cold and filtered water through one sleek fixture - without adding a separate drinking-water tap or drilling a second bench hole.

Just as importantly, **you do not need an Enviro Aqua filtration system to use it**. The dedicated filtered-water inlet is designed for compatible systems using a **standard 1/4" filtered-water connection**, including many under-sink and reverse osmosis systems from other brands.

## Everything Needed to Connect It

The tap is supplied with the **connection fittings required for a standard installation**, so there is no need to hunt down a separate fitting kit before installation. The setup is intentionally simple: connect the normal hot and cold supplies, connect the filtered-water line to the dedicated inlet, and the tap is ready to deliver all three water functions from one fixture.

For mains plumbing work, use a licensed plumber where required by local regulations.

## Brushed Nickel Finish

This model is supplied in **Brushed Nickel**. Choose a different finish using the links above; each finish has its own product page and stock.

## How 3-Way Works

A single tap body routes three water sources through dedicated internal pathways:

- **Hot** from the standard hot supply line
- **Cold** from the standard cold supply line
- **Filtered** from your compatible under-sink or reverse osmosis system

The filtered-water pathway remains separate from the normal hot/cold mixer supply, so filtered drinking water has its own dedicated route through the tap.

## Works With Standard Filtered-Water Connections

This tap is **not tied to one filter brand or one Enviro Aqua system**. It suits compatible filtration systems with a standard **1/4" filtered-water outlet**, including:

- Reverse osmosis systems
- Under-sink sediment and carbon filter systems
- Multi-stage under-sink filters
- Compatible systems from other brands using the same standard outlet format

That makes it a practical upgrade whether you already own a filtration system or are buying one separately.

## Why This Solves the Second-Tap-Hole Problem

Traditional under-sink filtration setups often use a separate drinking-water tap beside the kitchen mixer. On stone benchtops, single-hole sinks and new kitchens, that means another hole, another fixture and more visual clutter.

This 3-way mixer combines normal hot/cold water and filtered drinking water into one tap body, so you can keep a clean single-fixture sink area.

## Australian Compliance

**WaterMark certified** to **AS/NZS 3718** (Plumbing fittings - General requirements).

**WELS 4-star rated at 7.5 L/min** under AS/NZS 6400:2016. WELS registration number **T40393**.

## Where This Tap Fits

- Existing filtered-water systems using a standard 1/4" outlet
- Customers who already own a non-Enviro Aqua filtration system
- Kitchen renovations where you want filtered water without drilling a second tap hole
- Stone benchtops and single-hole sinks where an extra drinking-water tap is impractical
- New kitchen builds wanting a clean single-fixture bench
- Upgrades from a separate filter tap to a cleaner integrated setup
